annotations.title: Create a sound effect with ElevenLabs

description: Create a sound effect from its description with the person's own ElevenLabs account (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on this machine), and place it on a shot: made by an AI (the export says so). Describe the sound itself in English for the best result, short and concrete (« soft mouse click », « whoosh of a card sliding in »). The library's own sounds (search_library kind sfx, then edit_film add_sound) cost nothing: prefer them when one fits. One call costs the person's ElevenLabs credits.

beat.description: Beats after the start of that shot. Left out with `second` and `on`: on the shot's first frame

gain_db.description: Its level: 0 as it comes, -6 clearly quieter

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

on.description: Key of an element of that shot: the sound falls as that element comes in. Instead of beat or second

pan.description: -1 in the left ear, 1 in the right, 0 in the middle

second.description: Seconds after the start of that shot, instead of beats

seconds.description: Its length, 0.5 to 30 s. Left out: ElevenLabs chooses

text.description: What the sound is, in a few words

name: make_sound
